name: metpy-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is MetPy, a collection of tools in Python for reading, visualizing and performing
calculations with weather data. Its computation layer (`metpy.calc`, `metpy.interpolate`, `metpy.constants`,
`metpy.units` and the `metpy.xarray` accessors) works with unit-aware Pint quantities, NumPy arrays and xarray
objects.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is MetPy's computation layer under src/metpy/: every Python module of the metpy package except those in its io/, plots/ and remote/ subpackages (that is, the calc/, interpolate/, constants/ and _vendor/ packages and the top-level modules such as units.py, xarray.py, cbook.py, deprecation.py and package_tools.py); together with README.md, pyproject.toml, the pages docs/index.rst, docs/api/index.rst, docs/api/references.rst, docs/_templates/overrides/metpy.calc.rst and docs/_templates/overrides/metpy.xarray.rst, the user-guide pages docs/userguide/index.rst, startingguide.rst, installguide.rst, upgradeguide.rst, apichange.rst, citing.rst and media.rst, the tutorials tutorials/README.md, tutorials/unit_tutorial.py and tutorials/xarray_tutorial.py, the gallery files examples/README.txt, examples/calculations/README.txt, examples/gridding/README.txt and examples/calculations/Wind_Speed.py, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.
